messages:
Nina (Product): Heads-up - FinReg pilot wants guarantees around audit exports and BYOK handling. Need to scope pilot features.
Rahul (Security): Core asks: deterministic sampling + tamper-evident exports. BYOK must be used to wrap export keys.
Eve (Eng-Infra): We can add tenant `audit_policy` and `export_flow`. Indexing on request_id will speed selective exports. 2-week estimate for indexes + API.
Sam (Solutions): Customers will require signed manifests auditors can verify independently. Also want rotation scenario: if customer rotates KEK mid-retention, how do we prove continuity?
Priya (Legal): We'll need contract language: sampling disclosure, retained categories (auth/keystore ops full), export SLA, and key-rotation responsibilities.
ExportBot: Created TASK-20420: "pilot-export-manifest-spec" assigned to @Eve.
Rahul (Security): Manifest fields: manifest_version, sampling_seed, wrapped_data_key, file_list, manifest_signature. Use AES-256-GCM for data, RSA-PSS or ED25519 for signatures.
Eve (Eng-Infra): Implementation note: include `sampling_seed` so exports are reproducible. We'll log seed generation per-window.
Sam (Solutions): For demos: show BYOK provision -> export -> verify manifest -> simulate key rotation -> re-run export proving earlier bundle still verifiable.
Nina (Product): Proposed pilot checklist: 1) tenant policy API + Console intro, 2) signed export bundle with verification guide, 3) BYOK provisioning + rotation runbook, 4) retention tiers (30/90/365) exposed, 5) auditor walkthrough with 2 pilot customers.
Priya (Legal): I'll draft the pilot addendum and required audit wording.
Eve (Eng-Infra): Action items: TASK-20420 prototype manifest (WIP) and infra estimate.
Rahul (Security): I'll produce a short security spec for manifest signing/envelope encryption.
Nina (Product): Great. Sync Friday EOD to finalize scope. Drop blockers here."
